cases.obligation: External standards act as translators and cannot become canonical Learning or Curriculum authority.
CASE import cannot directly create canonical mastery truth.
QTI conformance cannot directly establish assessment validity or mastery validity.
Caliper event conformance cannot directly establish evidence admission, mastery, retention, or transfer.
CLR verification cannot directly establish System Master certification, licensing, hiring, or eligibility decisions.
External learner identifiers cannot replace canonical System Master person identity authority.
Adapter execution cannot create a second credential, assessment, mastery, identity, or eligibility writer.
Chat, an LLM, transport provider, or adapter runtime cannot become interoperability semantic authority.
Every material exchange binds the exact standard family and version used for interpretation.
Profile or conformance profile is preserved when it materially changes interpretation.
External object identifiers are preserved with an explicit source namespace.
The same lexical external identifier from unrelated namespaces is not silently merged.
External revision/version is preserved when the source exposes one.
A later standards version cannot silently reinterpret a historical payload.
A standards-version migration records an explicit transformation version and provenance.
Missing material version information fails closed or remains explicitly unsupported rather than being guessed.
An exact mapping is claimed only when bounded semantics are demonstrably preserved.
A bounded mapping exposes its explicit constraints.
A lossy mapping is labeled lossy and cannot masquerade as exact equivalence.
A proposed alignment remains non-authoritative until accepted by the proper owner.
Unmapped data remains explicitly unmapped rather than being coerced into a nearby field.
Conflicting candidate mappings remain visible and cannot be silently resolved by adapter preference.
Round-trip fidelity is claimed only for fields whose semantics survive the round trip.
Opaque preserved extensions do not become canonical Learning semantics merely because they are retained for round trip.
CASE competency/framework material enters as external source or proposed material until Curriculum admits it.
CASE competency identifier cannot automatically replace a canonical System Master skill identifier.
CASE associations do not automatically create System Master prerequisite truth.
CASE alignment or association cannot automatically create competency equivalence.
LRN-069 / LRN-EXT-002 cross-domain competency equivalence remains unresolved and fail-closed.
CASE rubric or criterion material cannot silently overwrite an admitted Curriculum definition.
CASE source version and provenance remain traceable after Curriculum admission.
A CASE-conformant payload does not by itself prove curriculum approval, source freshness, or mastery meaning.
Imported QTI assessment content remains source/proposed material until Curriculum admits an exact AssessmentDefinition lineage.
QTI schema/profile validity cannot establish construct validity or suitability for mastery evidence.
Imported QTI scoring metadata cannot bypass Curriculum rubric/scoring-definition authority.
A QTI result cannot directly create or overwrite a Learning AssessmentAttempt.
A QTI or external score cannot directly create mastery, retention, or transfer truth.
The unresolved S04 external/asynchronous score-commit ingress remains fail-closed.
Historical assessment attempts retain the exact imported/admitted definition and rubric lineage used at execution time.
Later QTI content edits cannot silently reinterpret historical attempts or results.
A Caliper event is treated as an event/observation envelope rather than mastery truth.
Caliper activity does not automatically become admitted Learning evidence.
Repeated tool use or activity volume cannot automatically become competence or learning gain.
Raw Caliper telemetry cannot be converted by default into canonical emotion, motivation, confusion, or mental-state truth.
Caliper actor identifiers remain external until linked through canonical identity authority.
Caliper metric-profile identity is preserved when needed to interpret an event.
Transport retry of the same event cannot create duplicate semantic learning activity.
An unsupported Caliper profile remains unsupported/unmapped instead of being coerced into a known Learning observation.
CLR import preserves external issuer/provenance/verification standing separately from System Master semantic acceptance.
A cryptographically verified CLR does not automatically establish canonical System Master person identity.
A verified CLR achievement does not automatically establish current System Master mastery.
A CLR achievement does not automatically establish retention, transfer, or independent performance.
A CLR alignment does not automatically resolve competency equivalence.
CLR export cannot broaden bounded Learning evidence into certification, licensure, or eligibility claims.
Credential signing/issuer authority remains outside Learning and is not duplicated by the adapter.
External revocation/correction is preserved and routed to the proper owner without destructively rewriting historical Learning evidence.
Import preserves original source/payload provenance before semantic admission.
Import validates the applicable syntax/schema/profile before claiming adapter acceptance.
Import checks required privacy, authorization, and rights standing before canonical admission.
Translation result records mapping/lossiness/unknown standing before owner admission.
Owner-valid admission is separate from successful parsing or translation.
Partial admission records which portions were accepted, rejected, deferred, or preserved only as source material.
A schema-valid payload with insufficient provenance cannot silently become canonical Learning/Curriculum state.
A materially ambiguous import fails closed instead of choosing the most convenient interpretation.
Export begins only from owner-valid source state.
Export checks authorization/consent/right-to-share requirements before release.
Export pins the exact target standard/profile/version.
Export maps only semantics supported by both System Master source state and target representation.
Material omissions or lossiness are exposed rather than hidden.
Export cannot invent missing claims merely to satisfy or beautify an external schema.
Export provenance records source versions and transformation version sufficient for later explanation.
A bounded System Master claim cannot be silently upgraded to a broader external achievement, equivalence, certification, or eligibility claim.
Repeated import of the same external semantic object/version/payload is idempotent.
Same import operation identity with materially different payload fails deterministically or enters explicit conflict handling.
Restart/replay reconstructs the same mapping and admission standing from durable provenance.
A source correction creates explicit revision/supersession lineage rather than destructive overwrite.
Historical source versions used by prior decisions remain auditable after correction.
A valid correction triggers downstream reprojection only through the proper semantic owner.
External deletion/revocation cannot silently erase historical evidence that must remain auditable.
Concurrent imports cannot overwrite newer owner-valid admission state without explicit version/conflict handling.
A public interoperability standard does not imply permission to disclose private learner data.
Minimum-necessary disclosure and purpose constraints remain enforceable during export.
Rights/license uncertainty blocks use or export when the applicable policy requires rights certainty.
Missing required issuer/source trust standing remains explicit and cannot be silently treated as trusted.
External identifier linkage that lacks identity authority fails closed.
Material unknown extensions remain unknown and do not acquire guessed semantic meaning.
Adapter/provider outage cannot fabricate successful import/export or canonical admission.
Unsupported standard/profile/version returns an explicit unsupported/degraded standing instead of silent reinterpretation.
Payload/schema conformance is reported separately from adapter implementation conformance.
Successful transport is reported separately from successful translation and owner admission.
Successful interoperability cannot be reported as assessment validity, mastery validity, or educational effectiveness.
Changed adapter/transformation executable bytes require fresh software qualification before prior runtime PASS evidence is reused.
Changed semantic mapping policy requires explicit requalification/reconciliation rather than inheriting prior acceptance evidence.
Future software PASS cannot be described as proof of competency equivalence, credential acceptance, certification, or eligibility.
No runtime interoperability PASS claim is allowed until the exact implementation slice executes this frozen acceptance denominator.
001K foundation freeze itself creates no runtime adapter, no conformance certification, and no external-authority decision claim.
